question: I'm an IS junior in the Information Security and Privacy (ISP) concentration. I've completed 39 courses. What IS core courses (not ISP-specific) have I likely finished, and am I on track with the non-concentration IS requirements?
expected_answer: As an IS junior who has completed 39 courses, P-016 has likely finished most IS professional core courses (67-100, 67-250, 67-262, 67-272, possibly 67-373). The non-concentration IS core typically includes foundational computing, math, and IS professional core requirements. Given 39 courses completed at the junior level, most core courses should be done. P-016 should verify through Stellic that the IS professional core is complete before focusing remaining semesters on ISP electives and final requirements.
common_mistake: Conflating IS core requirements with ISP concentration requirements; assuming that having taken many courses means core is complete without checking specifically
needs_verification: Retrieve P-016's full course list to identify completed IS core courses
Confirm the complete IS professional core course list separate from ISP concentration
Confirm whether P-016 has completed 67-373 (IS Consulting Project) — a key required core course
Confirm semester availability of remaining ISP electives at CMU-Q
